_note: Host-side validation of the four TRT formulations in model/moe/trt_ffn_moe.py, run on CPU torch 2.13 / onnx 1.22 / onnxruntime while the Jetson was offline. Establishes that the ONNX graphs are correct BEFORE spending a device cycle; the TensorRT build itself is still unmeasured and needs the Nano.
caveat_drop_frac: Measured with an UNTRAINED gate, which routes near-uniformly. The trained U8 routers ran at 5.05-5.51 effective experts of 8, so they are imbalanced and the capacity factor a deployment needs is k * max_share of the busiest expert, not 1.5.
